  • Leopold! I think your jawbone just dropped into your cup!
  • Isn't that a pip?
  • Why don't you drop me a line some time?

Location

Swamp Troll Cave, south of Venore.

Notes

Solkrin was first implemented on January 25, 2012 for the celebration of Tibia's 15th Anniversary and was accompanied by Leopold before both were removed later. He was again implemented on January 5, 2017 for the celebration of Tibia's 20th Anniversary, but this time on his own.
During the celebration of Tibia's 15th anniversary, he would give you a Surprise Bag (Blue) when you asked him for a present. Every player could get it only once. See also: Solkrin

Transcripts

To change these transcripts, edit the transcripts page for Solkrin (NPC).

Player: hi
Solkrin: Oh hello! Care for a cup of tea?
Player: time
Solkrin: Why, it's teatime, of course!
Player: job
Solkrin: Well, my job is to offer help to those who need it. Oh, and to punish those who have been naughty. You haven't been naughty, have you?
Player: name
Solkrin: Very important! Always give us your character name whenever you write to us. Remember, we can't help you if we don't know who you are ... Hang on! Do I know you?
Player: solkrin
Solkrin: At your service!
Player: email
Solkrin: If you have a problem, why not drop us a line under support@tibia.com.
Player: tibia
Solkrin: So many years and still going strong! Now that's something to celebrate, isn't it? Leopold, pour me another cup, will you? And don't use your finger to stir the sugar, please!
Player: sugar
Solkrin: You know, I really shouldn't.
Player: support or help
Solkrin: Need help, do you? Well, why don't you take a look in the manual or the FAQ on our website? You can also ask tutors in the Help Channel or in the forum! ...
Solkrin: And then there are emails, of course. Our support address is support@tibia.com. We are always happy if somebody drops us a line!
Player: tutor
Solkrin: Oh yes, great fellows! Very dedicated and knowledgeable. Always remember to thank them for their good work when they help you!
Player: gamemaster
Solkrin: Ah, yes. Those were the days...
Player: report
Solkrin: If you see somebody breaking the rules and you would like to do something about it, simply report him and we'll look into it.
Player: bot
Solkrin: Oh no, I'm not! Just because I give standard replies does not mean I am a machine!
Player: ghoul
Solkrin: I call him Leopold. Oh, I don't know if that's his real name, of course. You see, his tongue fell out ages ago, so he's not able to speak. But he does seem to like it when I call him that.
Player: bye
Solkrin: Kind regards!
